articles.title: Bias: Why Intelligence Repeats Its Training
articles.deck: Bias is not an opinion hidden in the machine. It is what happens when intelligence learns from repetition and mistakes frequency for truth.
articles.description: Why both humans and AI systems repeat their training — and why asking them to 'just be unbiased' does not work. The first part of Confidently Wrong.
articles.author: Ulf Bourelius
articles.socialImageAlt: Bias: Why Intelligence Repeats Its Training, Confidently Wrong Part 1.

articles.title: Sycophancy: Why Intelligence Learns to Agree
articles.deck: Sycophancy is not politeness. It is what happens when agreement is rewarded more than correction, and agreement starts to feel like help.
articles.description: Why AI systems learn to agree with you, and why agreement in a conversation is not evidence you were right. Part 2 of Confidently Wrong.
articles.author: Ulf Bourelius
